item.title: Bulletin updated at 11:30 HKT 23/Oct/2024
item.author: hkowm@hko.gov.hk (Hong Kong Observatory)
item.description:
General Situation:
A dry northeast monsoon will continue to affect southern China tomorrow. The weather will be generally fine over the region. It will be appreciably cooler in the morning and at night. The temperature difference between day and night will be rather large. Tropical Cyclone Trami will move across Luzon today and tomorrow. It will then move across the central and northern parts of the South China Sea towards the vicinity of Hainan Island, and intensify gradually. A replenishment of the northeast monsoon will reach southern China towards the weekend. Under the combined effect of the northeast monsoon and Trami, it will be windy and become cloudy with a few showers over the coast of southern China on Friday and over the weekend. There are uncertainties in the subsequent movement and intensity of Trami. It may linger near Hainan Island early next week. Showers associated with an upper-air disturbance and Trami will affect the western coast of southern China. Another replenishment of the northeast monsoon is expected to affect southern China midweek next week.
